about_the_game:
Somewhere, a cat sleeps

For those who have loved a cat.
For those who have lost one.

Walk between dream and reality, where time drifts without meaning. You can end everything in five minutes, or wander forever in your dreams.

One dream leads to another, and the searching never stops. A cat is always there, waiting, somewhere in the shifting haze. Each dream holds another inside it, opening like doors you didn’t know were there. Step through them, and the wandering begins again.

Explore the nothingness, the randomness, the endlessness. Forget about time. Read the poems of Khayyam by the fire. Push objects until they fall, or let them stand untouched. Stare into the abyss until it stares back. Do nothing. Do everything. Be like a cat.

What you get in the Demo:
One dream world, a glimpse into the story, cats in the box, meditating cat, purring cat, five poems.

What to expect in the full game:
Tens of dream worlds, full story mode, lots of cats, more poems, puzzles and challenges to discover new worlds, and more cats.

Features

  • Discover fragments of story within stillness and silence

  • Explore strange dream worlds, each holding its own secret logic

  • Find hidden paths from one dream into another

  • Breathe with the cats, and let them rest on you forever

  • Read timeless poems by Omar Khayyam

  • Watch as cats fall like rain from nowhere

  • Stumble upon surprising, unexpected dreams

  • A meditative walking simulator about patience, loss, and the philosophy of cats

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Between the veil of night and dawn, a cat once loved still wanders on. A meditative walking simulator about cats, patience, love, and loss.
